Menu bar ​

MenuEntriesPurpose
FileNew mission · Open scenario · Export results · ExitMission control, file I/O, shutdown
ViewHome · Operations · Analysis · Intelligence · Geolocation · Data & Sources · Full screenPerspective switching
RunStart / Stop paired mission · Rate presetsMission control and simulation speed
ToolsDiagnosticsSelf-test of the installation
HelpUser guide · AboutThis documentation; version information

Perspectives ​

PerspectivePurpose
HomeDashboard: headline stats, quick actions, system status
OperationsLive paired A/B mission with waterfall displays
AnalysisKPP gate table, Monte Carlo results, figure gallery
IntelligenceEmitter identification board with threat classification
GeolocationMulti-receiver AOA triangulation with CEP analysis
Data & SourcesSensor feeds, scenarios, model training

Toolbar ​

Run controls (start/stop), simulation-rate selector, quick access to Diagnostics and User Guide.

Status bar ​

Live state: READY or RUNNING - slot n/T, the product name, and the local port.
